description:
Activate Redshift by tapping it, adding an amount of {G} or {W} equal to its power that can only be spent to activate abilities.
Activate Seedcradle Witch by paying {2}{G}{W}, untapping Redshift and giving it +3/+3 until end of turn.
Repeat.
